title: Diagonale des Fous 2027 — parcours, barrières horaires et carte 3D
claims: The Reunion3D page, labelled “Diagonale des Fous 2027”, gives 180.6 km, +10,199 m D+ and a 66-hour limit; its 15–18 October dates name Thursday–Sunday, which matches 2026, not 2027.
Under that 2027 label, the page states the route removes the Cilaos cirque passage and the Col du Taïbit climb, going via Caverne Dufour, Cap Anglais and the Bélouve gîte into the Salazie cirque.
Under that 2027 label, the page states that Hell-Bourg replaces Cilaos as the first major base, with hot meal and drop bag.
The page offers a GPX download from its 2027-labelled course map.
Reunion3D is an independent third-party site, not the race organiser, and the page states no licence permitting redistribution of the GPX.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 Reunion3D 页面；页面标 2027，日期/星期却对应 2026，数字与官方 2026 不同。仅作第三方线索，不作赛道数值依据
